title.narrative: Flucht- und Migrationspolitik jenseits des Krisenmodus: Entwicklungsorientierte Strategiebildung im Kontext längerfristiger Herausforderungen
Refugee and Migration Policy Beyond Crisis Mode: Development-Oriented Strategy Formation in the Context of Longer-Term Challenges

description.narrative: To see the current state of knowledge on the effects of violence and fragility, climate change and economic disparities and their interactions on international migration processes processed in a form that can be used by the BMZ, to identify possible points of intervention and design options for a forward-looking, effective German flight and migration policy that is committed to human rights and embedded in Europe and geared towards international cooperation, and to have options for development policy named, to see the knowledge generated in the research projects supported by the BMZ network.
